description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Timer functionality, including scenarios for timer creation, operation, deactivation, reactivation, concurrency constraints, and integration with POCO grains. It verifies the behavior of timers in various conditions, ensuring correctness for a distributed grain-based system.

classes.name: TimerOrleansTest
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for Orleans Timer features such as start, stop, migration, concurrent operations, and integration with POCO grains.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Basic
methods.description: Tests basic timer lifecycle including start, execution, and stop, verifying expected ticks count and timer cessation.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Parallel
methods.description: Tests parallel execution of timers across multiple grains, ensuring independent timer operation.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Migration
methods.description: Verifies that timers do not persist across grain deactivation/reactivation cycles.

methods.name: AsyncTimerTest_GrainCall
methods.description: Tests asynchronous grain calls within timer callbacks, ensuring proper exception capture and callback execution.

methods.name: GrainTimer_TestAllOverloads
methods.description: Verifies that all timer creation overloads work correctly and execute callbacks.

methods.name: GrainTimer_DisposeFromCallback
methods.description: Ensures timers can dispose themselves safely from within their own callbacks.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_Test
methods.description: Checks that non-reentrant grains respect concurrency constraints when multiple timers are active.

methods.name: GrainTimer_Change
methods.description: Tests changing timer periods and due times dynamically, including edge cases and callback-initiated modifications.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Basic_Poco
methods.description: Tests basic timer functionality with POCO grains, verifying behavior matches grains derived from the base grain system.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Parallel_Poco
methods.description: Tests parallel timer execution in POCO grains ensuring timer isolation and independence.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Migration_Poco
methods.description: Verifies that POCO grains do not retain timers after deactivation, similar to traditional grains.

methods.name: AsyncTimerTest_GrainCall_Poco
methods.description: Validates async grain calls from POCO grain timers with proper exception handling.

methods.name: GrainTimer_TestAllOverloads_Poco
methods.description: Checks all timer registration overloads in POCO grains for correctness.

methods.name: NonReentrantGrainTimer_Test_Poco
methods.description: Ensures non-reentrant POCO grains respect concurrency constraints for timers.

methods.name: GrainTimer_Change_Poco
methods.description: Tests runtime modification of timer periods in POCO grains, including invalid and boundary values.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Basic_Poco
methods.description: Basic timer functionality test with POCO grains, confirming expected timer behavior.

methods.name: TimerOrleansTest_Migration_Poco
methods.description: Verifies timer non-persistence in POCO grains after deactivation.
